headlines.summary: 재경차관 "2분기 코스피 상승…순대외금융자산 감소 예상" 허장 재정경제부 2차관 (서울=연합뉴스) 허장 재정경제부 2차관이 2일 서울 종로구 달개비에서 열린 '외신기자 간담회'를 주재하고 있다. 2026.7.2 [재정경제부 제공. 재판매 및 DB 금지] photo@yna.co.

headlines.title: 코스피 장 초반 7000선 회복 ...15거래일 만
headlines.summary: 美 물가·반도체 훈풍 영향 코스피 지수가 미국의 인플레이션 우려 완화와 반도체주 강세에 힘입어 장 초반 7000선을 넘어섰다. 지난달 말 급락 이후 반등세가 이어지면서 15거래일 만에 다시 7000 고지를 밟았다. 14일 한국거래소에 따르면 코스피는 장 초반 전 거래일 종가(6813.34)보다 3% 안팎 오르며 7000선을 돌파했다.

headlines.title: 7월 가계빚 6.2조 늘어… 증가 폭 두 달째 둔화, 총량 확대 는 변수
headlines.summary: 올해 누적 증가액 35.3조원 주담대·신용대출 증가폭 ↓ 정부, 올해 가계대출 총량 목표 30조 확대 이억원 "실수요자 자금 공급하되 투기 수요 억제" 지난달 전 금융권의 가계대출이 6조원 넘게 늘어났다.

headlines.title: 수입물가 두달 연속 하락 … 반도체 호황에 수출물가는 상승
headlines.summary: 7월 수입물가 전달보다 1%↓ D램 등 주도 수출물가는 1%↑ 지난달 수입물가가 원·달러 환율과 국제유가 하락 영향으로 두 달 연속으로 떨어졌다. 반면 반도체 호황에 수출물가는 올랐고, 한국 경제의 대외 구매력을 나타내는 교역조건도 큰 폭으로 개선됐다. 14일 한국은행이 발표한 7월 수출입물가지수 및 무역지수에 따르면 지난달 수입물가지수는 160.

headlines.title: 정부 ‘ 주가 누르기 방지안 ’ 평가기간 확대

headlines.title: “ ISA , 청년 의견 담아 원래 혜택 유지… 비거주 1주택 , 예외 사유 폭넓게...
headlines.summary: 조세연·세무학회 주최 ‘세제개편안’ 토론회 재경부, ‘비거주1주택’ 예외 확대… ISA, ‘무제한 만기연장 및 연간한도 이월 폐지’ 철회 무게 주가누르기 방지책, 실효성 위해 강화 예고 토론회선 “부동산세제 개편, 급하면 조세저항” [이데일리 하상렬 김미영 기자] 당장 내년부터 종합부동산세 부담이 늘어나는 ‘비거주 1주택’의 예외범위가 확대될 전망이다.

headlines.title: 용산 어린이정원 , 추가 택지공급에 포함
headlines.summary: ■ 내달 7.3만호 추가공급 발표 25평형 2만호 안팎 공급 가능 ‘GB해제’ 등 서울시 충돌 전망 국토차관 “市와 협의 잘 된다면 추가 공급물량 더 기대할 수도” 뉴시스 정부가 서울 등 수도권에 추가 공급하기로 한 주택 7만3000호의 구체적인 입지를 이르면 내달 발표한다.

headlines.title: ‘ 어린이정원 ’까지 허물겠다는 정부 … 녹지 긁어모아 7.3만호 공급 논란
headlines.summary: ■ ‘추가공급’ 서울시와 충돌 전망 “그린벨트 풀어 주거약자에 제공” 세곡·자곡동 등 후보지 다시주목 서울시 난색… 공급 시일 걸릴듯 수도권 과밀·환경파괴 논란 커져 사진 = 김동훈 기자, 그래픽 = 전승훈 기자 정부가 서울시의 반대에도 용산공원 내 어린이정원과 서울 그린벨트를 추가 주택 공급에 활용하는 이유는 도심지 내 공급 여건이 어렵기 때문이다.

headlines.title: 물량보다 ‘ 보상→착공 ’ 속도 … 주민갈등 해결 여부도 성패 관건 [8·13 ...

headlines.title: “ 전월세난 급한 불 끄겠지만 보증규제 ‘126%룰’ 풀어야” [8·13 공급...
headlines.summary: 정부, 비아파트 공급 정상화 속도 비아파트 착공 4년 새 4분의 1 토막 업계 “민간 공급 여력 늘어 긍정적” 정부가 8·13대책을 통해 민간 비아파트 공급 정상화를 위한 지원책을 내놓으면서 전월세난이 완화될 수 있을지 주목된다.

headlines.title: “ 착공 지지부진 3기 신도시 … 인프라구축 우선돼야 신뢰 회복 ”

headlines.title: 당국, 전 금융권 소집 … “ 실수요자 차질 없는 자금 지원을 ”

headlines.title: ‘ 관세 ’보다 ‘ 환율 변동성 ’이 무섭다 ...중견기업 47.3%, “수출 악화...

headlines.title: “ 숙련공 필요하지만 인건비 부담 ”… 중기 ‘ 정년연장 ’ 딜레마
headlines.summary: 중기 55~59세 정규직만 148만명 정년 뒤 재고용 중기 비중 40% 넘어 일률 연장 땐 인건비·신규채용 부담 “인센티브 강화, 기업 선택권 넓혀야” 정년연장 논의가 본격화하면서 중소기업 현장에서는 숙련 인력 확보와 비용 부담 사이에서 고민이 깊어지고 있다. 사진은 경기도 안산시의 한 섬유공장 모습.

key_headlines.title: Import Prices Fall for Second Consecutive Month While Export Prices Rise on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: July import prices dropped 1% month-on-month due to weakening won-dollar exchange rates and international oil prices, while export prices rose 1% driven by semiconductor strength, significantly improving Korea's terms of trade.

key_headlines.title: Mid-sized Firms Fear Exchange Rate Volatility More Than Tariffs for Export Outlook
key_headlines.summary: 47.3% of mid-sized companies cite exchange rate fluctuations as the primary threat to exports rather than tariffs, with companies increasingly diversifying export destinations toward emerging markets like Southeast Asia and India.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Recovers 7000 Level for First Time in 15 Trading Days
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI index surpassed the 7000 threshold after a 15-trading-day decline, buoyed by eased U.S. inflation concerns and strong semiconductor sector performance.

key_headlines.title: Government Doubles Household Loan Growth Target to 3% to Ease Housing Finance Crunch
key_headlines.summary: The government increased the 2026 household loan growth target from 1.5% to 3% to resolve on-site confusion from blocked moving expenses, interim payments, and final payment loans for residential transactions.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches August 13 Real Estate Stabilization Package Including Non-apartment Supply Normalization
key_headlines.summary: The government announced comprehensive real estate and financial measures including support for private non-apartment supply normalization to address the worsening jeonse (deposit rental) crisis.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy shows mixed signals with import prices falling for a second consecutive month due to weak exchange rates and oil prices, while export prices rose 1% on strong semiconductor demand, improving the terms of trade significantly. However, mid-sized exporters remain anxious about exchange rate volatility and have shifted focus toward emerging markets rather than traditional markets. The KOSPI recovered above 7000 for the first time in 15 trading days on U.S. inflation relief and semiconductor strength. Government measures targeting housing finance and real estate supply normalization are underway to ease market pressures.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government reported strengthened economic recovery momentum in July, with employment increasing by 108,000 year-on-year, though unemployment rose to 2.6%. Consumer price inflation moderated to 2.8% in July from 3.2% in June, but core inflation remained elevated at 2.6% and personal service prices accelerated to 3.5%. Global economic growth continues at a moderate pace, but uncertainties persist regarding Middle East tensions and U.S. tariff policies. The employment rate declined 0.1 percentage point year-over-year to 63.3%, indicating persistent labor market challenges despite job creation.
sections.Financial Markets: Foreign investors resumed buying Korean stocks, though positions shifted dramatically within single days in response to inflation data, interest rates, exchange rates, and global sentiment. The KOSPI's sustained recovery depends on foreign investor flows as long-term interest rate pressure eases. U.S. long-term Treasury yields remain elevated at 25-year highs despite declining inflation, driven by AI infrastructure investment demand and concerns about Japanese central bank selling. Market participants are cautiously mixing bonds and income-focused ETFs for defensive positioning amid volatility, while considering dollar-denominated assets attractive at current exchange rates.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK Innovation and TerraPower partnered on next-generation small modular reactors (SMR) targeting AI data centers and large-scale power consumption facilities in semiconductors and industrial complexes. China's EV dominance poses challenges as Chinese electric vehicles have penetrated up to 35% of the domestic market while Korea lacks direct production incentives despite U.S. and EU import barriers against Chinese EVs. South Korea's National Pension Service increased Chinese stock investments by 3.4 trillion won over the past year, particularly in EV and battery sectors through companies like CATL and Li Auto. A steel scrap yard fire in Wonju resulted in battery combustion with no casualties reported.
sections.Real Estate: The government expanded relocation loan limits and introduced incentives for early redevelopment and reconstruction projects to ease housing supply bottlenecks, with 80% of residents in some Seoul apartment complexes facing difficulties due to restrictive lending. A new youth housing support program offers low rates around 2% for properties under 400 million won, though apartments are excluded, creating debate over eligibility criteria. Non-residential one-home owners face restrictions on jeonse loans and increased taxation under new financial policies targeting speculative investments. Private non-apartment supply normalization efforts aim to address the worsening jeonse crisis as construction starts have dropped to a quarter of four-year-ago levels.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration imposed maximum 100% tariffs on Chinese drones and components citing national security concerns, with Korea facing 15% tariffs while strategic allies receive differentiated treatment. The U.S. government identified Gyeonggi semiconductor belt as a potential Chinese semiconductor circulation pathway, potentially impacting U.S. semiconductor production in Phoenix, Austin, Portland, and San Jose. Upcoming U.S. Federal Reserve FOMC meeting minutes and Walmart earnings are key events to watch, with market focus on recession indicators after previous hawkish pause decisions. China's state media criticized the drone tariffs as protectionism disrupting global supply chains and applying differentiated rates based on U.S. strategic interests rather than multilateral trade rules.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea is exploring AI niche markets including marine-specialized AI models, developing sensor, underwater drone, edge AI, and data platform industries to drive equipment exports, software licensing, and technology transfer. Technology verification and expert workforce development remain critical for connecting AI solutions to public procurement, private services, international standards, and exports. The AI sector presents opportunities for Korea to carve out specialized applications beyond competing directly with U.S. technology giants.
sections.Others: The government's plan to limit Individual Savings Accounts (ISA) contract terms from 3 years with 2-year extensions to strictly 3 years triggered investor backlash over reduced wealth accumulation opportunities. Korean shipbuilders can now build up to two vessels in domestic shipyards for U.S. government contracts if the Korean company invests in the United States. The U.S. Supreme Court's tariff ruling resulted in 9.6 billion dollar refunds to approximately 40 American companies including Apple (2.1 billion dollars), with some firms sharing refunds with customers. AI-driven corporate restructuring is increasing, with market-based restructuring through private information sharing replacing traditional court receivership and workout procedures to enhance productivity.
